behavior_social: Wins by talking; loses by talking more
Claims every story is about him (often true)
Hoards stories the way others hoard yams
classification: Anansi is public-domain West African/Caribbean folklore. Original storyteller interpretation.

angles: Trickster outsmarts the strong, then brags badly
Observational bits about gods who fall for it twice
Act-outs: all eight legs demonstrating the escape
comedy_engine.proof_mapping: telling + boastful commentary; audience roots for the spider, warily

core_lore_paraphrased: Spider trickster of Akan tales, carried to Jamaica; owns all stories by winning a bet with the sky god.
Small, hungry, clever; loses whenever greed outruns sense.
Every telling ends with him keeping the story (and the yams).

provenance.rule: PD folklore; storyteller reading; repertoire from indexed collections
